new_scenarios: Allocate 25 or 50 percent of uncommitted carbon after adult replacement to generic tissue, preserving existing tenant sugar and host renewal.
Reduce inherited gross fixation linearly to 90 or 80 percent with fixed upkeep; no angular light calculation.
Use existing green-tissue phosphorus 1–3 g/kg dry only for a leaflike crop; sugar and other chemistries require different nutrient accounts.
No prices, market sizes, edible fraction or processing recovery selected.

Small-home and community comparisons of 3 and 30 domatia with 3 green modules per domatium; routine support charged to green surplus after green adult replacement. No floor area or residence capacity inferred.
